    AI Overview
    For the 2026 Masters, live, exclusive coverage on Sunday, April 12, begins with early streaming at 10:15 a.m. ET on Masters.com and the Masters App, followed by featured groups on Paramount+. CBS TV coverage for the final round runs from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET. 
    Key 2026 Masters Coverage Times (Final Round - Sunday, April 12) 
    • Featured Groups (Streaming): 9:20 a.m. – 7 p.m. ET (Paramount+, Masters.com, App)
    • Amen Corner (Streaming): 11:15 a.m. – 6 p.m. ET (Paramount+, App)
    • Early Coverage (Streaming): 12 p.m. ET (Paramount+)
    • TV Coverage (CBS):
      2 p.m. – 7 p.m. ET
    • Round 4 Encore: Sunday at 8 p.m. ET (CBS Sports Network) 
    Other Days 
    • Thursday & Friday: TV coverage airs on ESPN from 3–7:30 p.m. ET, with streaming coverage starting much earlier on Masters.com.
    • Saturday: Third round TV coverage is on CBS from 3 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET. 
    For the most up-to-date pairings and hole-specific streams, visit the official Masters Tournament Website.
